RESULTS May 15, 2025 Advice IT Infinite ADVICE TB / ADVICE.BK Margin beat lifts earnings outlook Sector: Commerce NEUTRAL Rating: BUY Target Price: Bt7.60 (upsized from Bt7.00) Price (May 14, 2026): Bt6.00 1Q26 NPAT beat our estimate and the street ADVICE reported 1Q26 NPAT of Bt116m, up by 83% YoY and 84% QoQ. The result beat our estimate by 31% and the Bloomberg consensus by 27%, driven by a much fatter GM than assumed. GM was 12.4%, up by 210bps YoY and 190bps QoQ, and 100bps above our assumption. The margin beat was supported by three factors: 1) low- cost IT DIY inventory on -hand (14% of revenue ), 2) stronger marketing support from brand owners , and 3) bigger proportions of commercial and B2B sales in the sales mix. Result highlights 1Q26 sales totaled Bt4.31bn, up 8% YoY and flat QoQ. The YoY sales growth was driven by a 12% YoY increase in retail sales, which offset the effect of a 1% YoY decline in wholesale sales ( 27% of sales ). Retail SSSG was 4%, while the iStore count rose to 21 stores, up by 14 outlets YoY and four outlets QoQ. GM was marked at 12.4%, up from 10.3% in 1Q25 and 10.5% in 4Q25. The fatter GM outweighed the effect of a higher SG&A /sales ratio of 9.1%, up by 80bps YoY and 50bps QoQ, mainly due to heavier online platform fee expenses. Outlook We expect 2Q26 core profit to rise YoY, driven by four factors: 1) the openings of four to six new iStore outlets, 2) a larger commercial customer base, 3) higher IT product sales prices, and 4) faster sales growth. Sales growth accelerated to above 10% YoY from Apr to mid - May. Year-on-year GM expansion will also be supported by another two to three months of low-cost inventory on hand. What has changed? We have upsized our 2026 core profit forecast by 26% to factor in a sharply fatter GM for sales of IT DIY products. Our 2026 core profit forecast now stands at Bt393m, up 43% YoY. 1Q26 core profit comprises 30% of our upsized 2026 projection. Recommendation Our BUY stands and our YE26 target price upsizes from Bt7 to Bt7.60, pegged to a 2026 PER of 12x, close to ADVICE’s historical average. The company is now entering a harvest ing phase for its smartphone channel expansion, while low -cost inventory should support GM upside. A high annual dividend yield of 8-9% adds to the appeal.
